title: The rail's hover card closes when the pointer moves onto it
body:
Hovering a rail tile shows the workspace's card beside the rail. `Frame::hover` only counts the top bar and the sidebar as chrome, so moving the pointer from the tile onto the card clears the hover and the card disappears.

## Proposal

The popover's rect counts as part of the hovered tile while the card is shown, so the card stays while the pointer is on it. A click on the card shows its workspace, as a click on the tile does.
close_reason: Landed in 984fd9f. `Frame::hit` counts the card and the gap before it as the hovered tile.
